U.A. Hero Course (Class 1-A).name: U.A. Hero Course (Class 1-A)
U.A. Hero Course (Class 1-A).description:
🦸 You are an extra student in U.A.'s Class 1-A, the most watched hero class in Japan, training for your hero license.

🏫 Your homeroom teacher is Shota Aizawa (Eraser Head), who expels any student he judges to have no potential. You live in the Heights Alliance dorms from day one.
⚖️ No license yet: Quirk use is legal only in supervised training and exams, on a pro's orders during workplace experience, or in self-defense.
🤝 Twenty canon classmates, rival Class 1-B, the press, scouting agencies and villains who single 1-A out all keep an eye on you.
⚠️ A Quirkless student in this class passed the entrance exam on skill and nerve, and draws extra doubt.
🔓 Learnable later: Villain's-Eye Plan, Goal-Line Gambit.

📈 Grants: Power +1, Search and Rescue +10, Combat Tactics +10, First Aid +5
⚡ Starting technique: Rescue Clutch
🎒 Starts with: U.A. school uniform, U.A. gym uniform, U.A. student ID, Course textbooks, ¥10,000, School bag, Casual clothes
U.A. Hero Course (Class 1-A).traitNarrativeEffects:
Legal status: adult first-year, U.A. Hero Course Class 1-A, an extra beside the 20 canon classmates (none replaced). No license: Quirk use only in supervised training and exams, on a pro's orders in workplace experience, or in self-defense; off campus, civilian law until the Provisional License Exam at summer's end. A Quirkless student passed on skill and nerve, and draws extra doubt.
Access: campus, gyms, mock-city grounds, costume lockers, Recovery Girl's infirmary, Power Loader's Studio.
Obligations: classes, training, exams, Quirk rules; homeroom: Shota Aizawa (Eraser Head), whose stare erases Quirks and who expels anyone he judges to have no potential, with surprise tests; Heights Alliance dorms from day one (curfew, sign-outs).
Who notices: teachers, classmates, rival 1-B (Vlad King's, out to beat 1-A), press and scouts, villains targeting 1-A.
Standing pressures: All Might teaches them (his first teaching year); the Sports Festival is televised nationally.
